jobs.description: Full-time (100%), permanent Lecturer (Teaching and Research) position in the School of Civil Engineering, Faculty of EAIT, based at the St Lucia Campus in Brisbane. The role involves teaching and research in structural engineering, course coordination, supervision of higher degree research students, and developing an impactful research program. A completed PhD in Structural Engineering and/or Civil Engineering is required.
jobs.summary: Full-time permanent Lecturer (Teaching and Research) in the School of Civil Engineering at St Lucia, Brisbane, for a civil engineering academic with a strong background in structural engineering, joining the structural engineering research group.
jobs.title: Lecturer in Structural Engineering

jobs.description: Fixed-term, full-time Postdoctoral Research Fellow (1 year) in the School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, based at Gardens Point. The ARC Industrial Transformation Research Hub in IoT for Water is recruiting one fellow to undertake an integrated research program spanning low-cost water sensing, sampling and monitoring network design, combining water-quality and catchment science with sensor hardware, electronics, telemetry, experimental validation and data analytics. A completed PhD in environmental, electrical/electronic or civil engineering, instrumentation, environmental science or a related field is required. Remuneration $96,342 to $130,727 pa (LEVA) inclusive of $81,410 to $110,466 salary pa, 17% superannuation and 17.5% recreation leave loading.
jobs.summary: Fixed-term full-time Postdoctoral Research Fellow in the School of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Gardens Point, Brisbane, in the ARC Industrial Transformation Research Hub in IoT for Water, working on low-cost water sensing, sampling and monitoring network design.
jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Smart Water Monitoring

jobs.description: Post-doctoral Research Fellow Level 1 (temporary, 18 months) in the UCD School of Civil Engineering, researching satellite-based monitoring and prediction of ground movement and soil moisture variations along Ireland's road and railway networks. The research uses high-resolution satellite radar observations, including Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Interferometric SAR (InSAR), combined with machine-learning methods to estimate soil moisture and forecast ground movement, producing national-scale monitoring datasets and risk-assessment tools for transport infrastructure. Applicants should be early-stage researchers who have recently completed a PhD.
jobs.summary: Post-doctoral Research Fellow Level 1 in the UCD School of Civil Engineering for an 18-month project on satellite-based monitoring and prediction of ground movement and soil moisture variations along Ireland's road and railway networks, using SAR and InSAR.
jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Satellite-Based Ground Movement and Soil Moisture Monitoring

jobs.description: Fixed-term, whole-time postdoctoral position (24 to 36 months) in the School of Engineering and Architecture at University College Cork, embedded in a project on the long-term service performance and safety of ageing tunnels under climate change. The research focuses on an AI-empowered digital twin framework for in-service tunnel evaluation, with field data collection, digital twin development and modelling of hydro-induced loading states. The postdoc works at UCC for the first eight months and is then seconded to CERN. Applicants should hold a PhD or equivalent in civil engineering or a closely related field (Recognised Researcher R2 profile). Salary is on the IUA PD1 Research Salary Scale.
jobs.summary: Postdoctoral researcher in the School of Engineering and Architecture working on an AI-empowered digital twin framework for the long-term service performance and safety of ageing tunnels under climate change, with particular attention to ageing tunnel infrastructure associated with CERN.
jobs.title: Post-Doctoral Researcher in Civil Engineering (AI-Powered Digital Twin for Ageing Tunnels)

A joint faculty search with the Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (IDSS) is also open.
jobs.summary: MIT Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering invites applications for tenure-track faculty positions at the level of Assistant Professor to begin July 1, 2027, or on a mutually agreed date thereafter. jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Civil and Environmental Engineering

jobs.description: UBC Vancouver Department of Civil Engineering invites applications for a full-time tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Structural and Earthquake Engineering, starting July 1, 2027, with access to the Earthquake Engineering Research Facility and Structures Laboratory. The successful candidate will develop an independent, internationally recognized research program, teach undergraduate and graduate courses, supervise graduate students, and hold a PhD in Civil Engineering or a closely related field with eligibility for P.Eng. registration in British Columbia.
jobs.summary: UBC Vancouver Department of Civil Engineering invites applications for a full-time tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Structural and Earthquake Engineering, starting July 1, 2027, with access to the Earthquake Engineering Research Facility and Structures Laboratory. Salary is $130,000–150,000/year at Assistant Professor rank; review of applications commenced October 1, 2026 and continues until the position is filled.

jobs.description: UBC Vancouver Department of Civil Engineering invites applications for a full-time tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Project and Construction Management, starting July 1, 2027. The successful candidate will develop an independent, internationally recognized research program, teach undergraduate and graduate courses, supervise graduate students, and hold a PhD in Civil Engineering or a closely related field with eligibility for P.Eng. registration in British Columbia.
jobs.summary: UBC Vancouver Department of Civil Engineering invites applications for a full-time tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Project and Construction Management, starting July 1, 2027, with priority for research in digital transformation, sustainable lifecycle management and equitable delivery of civil infrastructure systems. Salary is $130,000–150,000/year at Assistant Professor rank; review commenced October 1, 2026 and continues until filled.
jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Civil Engineering – Project and Construction Management

jobs.description: University of Waterloo Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering seeks one tenure-stream Assistant Professor in Geotechnical Engineering starting September 1, 2027. The successful candidate must have a PhD in civil or geotechnical engineering or a related discipline, obtain a Canadian engineering licence, and will teach at undergraduate and graduate levels, supervise graduate students and develop an actively developing research program, with experimental and field-based research viewed favourably.
jobs.summary: University of Waterloo Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering seeks one tenure-stream Assistant Professor in Geotechnical Engineering starting September 1, 2027, with favourable areas including energy geotechnics, soil-structure interaction, geomechanics, deep geological waste repositories, permafrost engineering and mining. Salary range is $120,000 to $160,000.
jobs.title: Assistant Professor – Tenure Stream Position in Geotechnical Engineering

jobs.description: University of Waterloo Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering seeks one teaching-stream Assistant Professor in Geotechnical Engineering starting September 1, 2027. The successful candidate must have a PhD in civil or geotechnical engineering or a related discipline, obtain a Canadian engineering licence, and demonstrate outstanding teaching ability, including courses in the civil, environmental, geological and architectural engineering programs.
jobs.summary: University of Waterloo Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering seeks one teaching-stream Assistant Professor in Geotechnical Engineering starting September 1, 2027, teaching courses such as Geotechnical Engineering 1–3 and Soil Mechanics and Foundations, with significant geotechnical industry experience preferred. Salary range is $100,000 to $140,000.
jobs.title: Assistant Professor – Teaching Stream Position in Geotechnical Engineering

jobs.description: UT Austin Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural, and Environmental Engineering invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor in geotechnical engineering with expertise in advanced computational geotechnics. The candidate's research should address innovative computational methods for analyzing, modelling and predicting the behaviour of geotechnical systems across multiple spatial and temporal scales, and the successful candidate must hold a PhD in engineering or a related area and develop an externally sponsored research program.
jobs.summary: UT Austin Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural, and Environmental Engineering invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor in geotechnical engineering with expertise in advanced computational geotechnics, including constitutive and multi-physics modelling, digital twins, data-enabled computational geomechanics and resilient infrastructure systems. Review of applications began November 15, 2026 and continues until a candidate is identified.
jobs.title: Assistant Professor- Advanced Computational Geotechnics- Fall 2027

jobs.description: University of Alberta Faculty of Engineering seeks a full-time tenure-track Assistant or Associate Professor in sustainable transportation futures, associated with Dr. Susan Shaheen's Eddie Goldenberg Research Chair of Canada in Sustainable Transportation Futures. Areas of interest include clean transportation technologies and energy systems involving electrification, hydrogen, sustainable fuels, critical minerals, vehicle-grid integration and distributed energy resources, and the academic home will be determined by the candidate's expertise.
jobs.summary: University of Alberta Faculty of Engineering seeks a full-time tenure-track Assistant or Associate Professor in sustainable transportation futures, associated with Dr. Susan Shaheen's Eddie Goldenberg Research Chair, for research advancing sustainable, resilient and inclusive transportation systems. The position is on-site in Edmonton and the successful candidate must have been working and residing outside Canada on July 1, 2026 and be able to start by July 1, 2027.
jobs.title: Canada Impact+ Emerging Leader. Assistant or Associate Professor in Sustainable Transportation Futures

jobs.description: UC Berkeley Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering is generating a pool of qualified temporary lecturers to teach courses in areas including energy, civil infrastructure and climate, construction systems, environmental engineering, geosystems, structural engineering, mechanics and materials, systems and transportation engineering. Applicants are considered as needs arise and the existence of the pool does not guarantee a position; applicants must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire.

The postholder will plan, resource and direct an original research programme in geotechnical engineering and contribute to undergraduate and taught postgraduate teaching in soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering.
jobs.summary: Assistant Professor in Geotechnical Engineering in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Geotechnics Section, at Imperial College London, to lead research and teach soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering.
jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Geotechnical Engineering

jobs.description: Associate Professor or Professor in Geotechnical Engineering in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Imperial College London. The postholder will plan, resource and direct an original and impactful research programme in geotechnical engineering and contribute to undergraduate and postgraduate education in soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering.
jobs.summary: Associate Professor or Professor in Geotechnical Engineering in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Imperial College London, to lead an impactful research programme and teach soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering.
jobs.title: Associate Professor or Professor in Geotechnical Engineering

jobs.description: Research Associate on an EPSRC project to improve seismic safety and resilience of communities living in Uganda. The postholder will analyse seismological, geological, tectonic and built-environment data, develop vulnerability and fragility curves using numerical methods, implement exposure models, perform risk calculations and develop seismic risk management strategies, working with academic teams in Uganda.
jobs.summary: Research Associate on an EPSRC project to improve seismic safety and resilience of communities in Uganda, developing seismic hazard, vulnerability and exposure models in the Earthquake Engineering group at the University of Sheffield.
jobs.title: Research Associate in Seismic Hazard, Vulnerability and Risk Assessment

jobs.description: Research Fellow in Energy Geostructures in the School of Civil Engineering at the University of Leeds, on the EPSRC-FAPESP project Efficient Ground Energy Systems in Diaphragm Walls in Challenging Conditions, led by Prof Fleur Loveridge. The postholder will lead research into the design and analysis of energy retaining walls used as ground heat exchangers, including numerical simulation, analytical modelling of planar heat flow, and laboratory and field-scale testing.
jobs.summary: Research Fellow in Energy Geostructures in the School of Civil Engineering at the University of Leeds, leading research on the design and thermal analysis of energy retaining walls used as ground heat exchangers.
jobs.title: Research Fellow in Energy Geostructures

jobs.description: DFG-funded PhD position (FatigueID project) at the Chair and Institute of Highway Engineering (ISAC) of RWTH Aachen University, researching the development of fatigue damage in asphalt mixtures. Work combines cyclic indirect tensile tests with digital image correlation and X-ray CT, mesoscale finite-element models with cohesive-zone approaches, and probabilistic analysis of fatigue-life scatter. The position offers a PhD at RWTH Aachen, is initially limited to 3 years, is part-time at three-quarters of regular working hours, and is graded EG 13 TV-L.
jobs.summary: DFG-funded PhD position at the Chair and Institute of Highway Engineering (ISAC) researching multiscale fatigue damage modelling of asphalt mixtures, combining fatigue testing, digital image correlation, CT imaging, mesoscale finite-element modelling and probabilistic damage analysis; EG 13 TV-L, initially 3 years, part-time at 75%.
jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in (w/m/d) - Promotionsstelle zur multiskaligen Modellierung von Ermüdungsschädigung in Asphaltmischgut

jobs.description: Research assistant in the new Chair of Railway Superstructure at RWTH Aachen University, starting 1 January 2027. Research covers the behaviour and condition development of railway superstructure systems and their technical and economic development under real operating, environmental and maintenance conditions, including system behaviour, condition and degradation, and maintenance and intervention engineering. The role includes independent PhD work, publications, teaching and supervision of theses, is limited to 5 years, full-time, and graded EG 13 TV-L.
jobs.summary: Research assistant in the new Chair of Railway Superstructure at RWTH Aachen (starting 1 January 2027), researching the behaviour and condition development of railway track systems and the optimisation of maintenance and renewal; PhD possible, 5 years, EG 13 TV-L, full-time.
jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in (w/m/d) im Forschungsbereich Eisenbahnoberbau

jobs.description: Research assistant (reference VI-404/26) at Technische Universität Berlin, Faculty VI – Planning Building Environment, Institute of Civil Engineering, Chair of Design and Construction – Steel Construction. The role carries out a DFG-funded cooperation project on reliability-based optimisation of the fatigue strength of welded structural details in steel construction, combining fatigue tests, measurement of weld geometries, numerical simulation (FE analyses) and probabilistic modelling. Requires a Master's degree in civil engineering; 100% working time (part-time possible), salary grade E13 TV-L Berliner Hochschulen, from 1 March 2027 to 28 February 2030.
jobs.summary: Research assistant in steel construction (Faculty VI, Institute of Civil Engineering, Chair of Design and Construction – Steel Construction) on a DFG-funded project on reliability-based optimisation of the fatigue strength of welded structural details in steel construction; E13 TV-L Berliner Hochschulen, 1 March 2027 to 28 February 2030.

jobs.description: Research assistant at the Institute of Water Quality and Waste Management (ISAH), Leibniz Universität Hannover, in urban water management and industrial water and material cycles. Work covers research and research-oriented teaching, model-based approaches and digital twins for process and material-flow optimisation, smart control strategies and circular water and material cycles, alongside operation of laboratory, pilot and full-scale plants. Requires a degree in civil and environmental engineering with a focus on urban water management; initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of extension for a PhD, EG 13 TV-L, 100%, with mobile working/home office possible by agreement. No closing date is stated on the official job page, so none is given here.
jobs.summary: Research assistant at the Institute of Water Quality and Waste Management on urban water management and industrial water and material cycles, including digital twins, modelling and lab, pilot and full-scale plant operation; PhD possible, initially 2 years, EG 13 TV-L, 100%.
